9
A skier is pulled up a short straight slope at constant speed by a rope.
rope
The tension in the rope is 100N and there is a combined frictional and air resistance force of 20N
acting on the skier.
The slope is 10m long and the skier rises 1.5m vertically.
How much work is done by the rope pulling the skier up the slope?
A
120J
B
150J
C
1000J
D
1200J
